'Would be a different country': Burke defends migration as Taylor policy criticism mounts

Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke says the Opposition's new immigration policy won't make Australians any safer and is designed to "send a message" to One Nation.

Opposition Leader Angus Taylor has unveiled part one of the Coalition's highly anticipated immigration policy during his first major policy speech since taking the top job in February.

Trump-style social media screening and a requirement to learn English are just some of the measures being put forward by the Opposition as part of its proposed mission to "boot out" those who don't abide by Australian values.

But Burke dismissed the Coalition's intention to prioritise migrants from liberal democracies, saying it aims to take Australia in the wrong direction.

"This concept that somehow you are more worthy if you come from a liberal democracy, is a view that I have not previously heard a senior Australian politician make," he said.

"Australia is and always should be a country where we judge you by who you are, not where you'r
title: 'Would be a different country': Burke defends migration as Taylor policy criticism mounts

New UK Immigration Rules: What Applicants Must Do in 2026

Think your UK visa is safe once it is granted? Under the new UK immigration rules, approval is no longer the end of the story.
HC 1691 shows that applicants must stay compliant, keep meeting the rules, and avoid mistakes that can damage future status.

I am Sajjad Kayani, a UK immigration, family law and litigation solicitor in England and Wales with more than 20 years of experience. In this video, I explain what applicants are now expected to do after a visa is granted, why compliance matters more than ever, and how simple errors can create serious immigration problems later. This is especially important for anyone dealing with UK visa compliance, Skilled Worker visa rules, partner visa requirements, settlement applications, Administrative Review, Appendix Finance, English language evidence, and Life in the UK test issues.

At Kayani Legal, we are a LEXCEL-accredited law firm based in Ilford, London, advising individuals and families on complex UK immigration rules, family law matters
title: New UK Immigration Rules: What Applicants Must Do in 2026
